subject: Paraprofessional Contract Ratification and Personnel Expansion
overview: The School Committee ratified labor agreements for paraprofessionals and authorized the expansion of two after-school site coordinator positions to full-time status.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy regarding contracts for paraprofessionals, nurses, and cafeteria workers.

items.title: Paraprofessional Association Contract Ratification
items.summary: Approved the ratification of a labor agreement consisting of one-year and three-year deals that include wage increases, school day extensions, and flexible duty scheduling for tasks like bus monitoring.

items.title: After-School Site Coordinator Positions
items.summary: Approved elevating two part-time site coordinator positions to full-time status to manage increased student capacity and expanded coordination with City Year staff.
